title: focuser_primaluce did not publish the ARCO angle during a move
summary: The rotator movement finalizer read the angle every 0.2 s during a move but published ROTATOR_POSITION only when the move ended, so clients showed the start angle until arrival.
evidence: 20261023111747-3b69-primaluce-rotator-progress/verification.md (FND); requester report 2026-10-23 on the SESTO SENSO 3

resolution.evidence: 20261023111747-3b69-primaluce-rotator-progress/verification.md: the rotator finalizer publishes the angle on every poll; rotator_move and sestosenso3_rotator_move pass and fail without it; recorded run 65/65; hardware angle counted up during a move.
